prompts.prompt: A small group of visitors stands inside the grand entrance hall of Dramaten at Nybroplan, listening to a guide in a dark wool coat who gestures toward the arched windows and marble floor under soft daylight spilling through tall glass panes.

A woman in a linen apron leans over a wooden table inside Kulturhuset Dieselverkstaden's Märtas målarsal, demonstrating embroidery stitches to a small group of seated participants as pale autumn light falls across scattered thread skeins.

Inside a quiet Stockholm yoga studio with pale plaster walls and tall windows, an instructor in loose grey clothing guides a small class through gentle floor stretches on simple cork mats under soft northern daylight.

A close-up of weathered hands pulling a needle and rust-red thread through natural linen fabric, with a worn wooden embroidery hoop and small ceramic bowl of buttons resting on a scuffed craft table in soft window light.
